scope: Layout/state grammar for all 150 existing cards. No new card definitions, illustrations, costs, effects, levels or rarity classes.

branches.dual: two equal-sized icon/name groups on the same row, source order retained
branches.overflow: compact label in market, full canonical branch names in inspection; no merged third branch symbol

hierarchy.location: upper-left, short label plus shape notch
upper-right badge, clear numeral; 44 logical-pixel visual box
below rarity/cost row, max two lines, opaque backing
under title, equal treatment for two branches
middle, cropped inside safe art window; no text embedded in art
below art, two readable lines; tap card for exact effect
bottom rail; state left, level right, never over illustration

selected.visual: focus border and explicit selection check/text

unavailable.visual: muted rarity accent, lock/reason label; retain readable content

owned.action: upgrade availability comes from canonical model, not artwork

maxed.visual: MAX badge and final level, no implied upgrade arrow
maxed.action: purchase/upgrade disabled when actual rules require

state_precedence: Maxed/unavailable governs purchase availability; selected is an independent overlay; owned and level persist. Rarity/branch identity never disappear under disabled styling.
level_policy: Display authoritative current/max level. The known Normal/Epic/Legendary level counts come from data; the proof uses explicitly synthetic display fixtures only.

phone_proof.tap_target: whole card plus bottom 44-high action button
phone_proof.status: temporary planning artifact; actual platform safe areas, runtime UI and physical-device legibility remain v1.19+ validation

text_overflow: Never shrink critical text below body minimum. Prefer two-line title, concise authored summary and full text in inspection. A future fourth/fifth card layout must be revalidated, not scaled down from this proof.
forbidden: Rare/Mythic labels from legacy frame sheet
level stars that contradict canonical data
